name: Honey Coming
source:
HoneyComing's story revolves around the protagonist [url=/c91025]Ogata Kouichirou[/url], a male first-year high school student who does not have any interest in matters such as love or romance. The high school he is admitted to, named Aikyou Academy, used to be an all-girl school formally named Aikyou Girl's Academy, and still carries a high population of female students. He starts school with his childhood friend [url=/c26780]Kamijou Asahi[/url], his younger step-sister [url=/c26784]Ogata Mio[/url], and best male friend [url=/c45848]Shinozaki Masanori[/url]. Kouichirou eventually meets two more female upperclassmen from the same school named [url=/c26783]Maezono Clarissa Satsuki[/url], and [url=/c26785]Shichiri Yuma[/url], along with a female underclassman from an affiliated school named [url=/c26786]Tagaya Marino[/url]; Kouichirou becomes friends with them. Since the school used to only have female students, there are certain classes oriented towards girls which are still required to take, such as lessons on love and romance.

These lessons are known as Love-making Lessons, and students at Aikyou are required to take these classes on how to fall in love, and the ways of proper romance techniques. Each lesson, two people (of the opposite sex) pair up to make something, such as a meal for example, and they must form good communication if they intend to pass the test. There are also tests on practical skills which required note taking to later be studied for tests. During these lessons, students from Aikyou, and a nearby affiliated junior-high school, are combined for a total range of six grades from the lowest to the highest. Each time, forty new students from either school are chosen to taken part in a special class for the Love-making Lessons. The students in the special class this year include: Kouichirou, Asahi, Clarissa, Mio, Yuma, Marino, Kaoru, Masanori, and Hiroko. Two teachers are assigned to this class: [url=/c45841]Raidou Ichigo[/url] (who is in charge of the boys), and [url=/c45842]Kurebayashi Tsukasa[/url] (who is in charge of the girls).

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Honey_Coming]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
《HoneyComing》的故事围绕主人公绪方浩一郎展开，他是一名对恋爱毫无兴趣的男高中生。他就读的爱桥学园前身是一所名为爱桥女子学院的女校，至今仍拥有大量女学生。他和青梅竹马上条朝日、继妹绪方美绪以及最好的男性朋友篠崎正则一起入学。浩一郎最终还结识了两位同校的女前辈——前园克拉丽莎·小月和七里优马，以及来自附属学校的女学弟�多贺谷真里乃。由于学校过去只有女学生，某些面向女生的课程至今仍是必修课，比如关于恋爱的课程。

这些课程被称为恋爱实习课，爱桥学园的学生必须修习如何坠入爱河以及正确的恋爱技巧。每堂课上，两人（异性）组队制作某样东西，比如一顿饭，如果他们想通过考试就必须良好沟通。还有实技考试，需要做笔记以便复习。在这些课程中，爱桥学园和附近附属中学的学生被合并在一起，涵盖从低年级到高年级的六个年级。每次从两所学校各选出40名新生参加恋爱实习课的特别班。今年特别班的学生包括：浩一郎、朝日、克拉丽莎、美绪、优马、真里乃、薰、正则和弘子。两位老师被分配到这个班级：[url=/c45841]雷堂一护[/url]（负责男生）和[url=/c45842]红林司[/url]（负责女生）。
